SELECT 
                      E.[Id]
                    , E.[Title]
                    , E.[Author]
                    , E.[Genre]
                    , E.[ISBN]
                    , E.[Description]
                    , E.[AuditId]

                FROM [dbo].[Book] E

                WHERE ? = ?
                  AND E.[Id]     IN (@Id1)
                  
                  
                  
            

            ORDER BY E.[Id] DESC
            OFFSET @Skip ROWS FETCH NEXT @Limit ROWS ONLY

            SELECT COUNT(*) FROM(
                SELECT 
                      E.[Id]
                    , E.[Title]
                    , E.[Author]
                    , E.[Genre]
                    , E.[ISBN]
                    , E.[Description]
                    , E.[AuditId]

                FROM [dbo].[Book] E

                WHERE ? = ?
                  AND E.[Id]     IN (@Id1)
                  
                  
                  
            ) a
